id.description: The unique identifier for the job.

status.description: The status code of the job. 0 = Active/Queued, 1 = Complete, 2 = Cancelled.

progress.description: The progress of the job as a percentage.

createdAt.description: The date and time the job was created.

startedAt.description: The date and time the job started running.

endedAt.description: The date and time the job finished.

finishCode.description: The completion code. 0 = success, 1 = error, 2 = cancelled.

title.description: A description of what the job is doing.
